sketchMechanisms: The Maybe type and pattern matching: a value wrapped in Maybe can be Nothing or Just a — the program must explicitly handle absence.
weak references: a weak var automatically becomes nil when the object it refers to is deallocated, requiring optional unwrapping to check if it still exists.
Lua tables use metatables with __index to delegate failed lookups to a parent — a child searches for what it cannot find in itself by looking to what came before.
